en: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, as a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula in the eastern Pyrenees
Its borders with France to the north and Spain to the south
zh: 安道尔正式称安道尔公国，是伊比利亚半岛东比利牛斯山区的内陆国家

politics.zh: 安道尔公国是伊比利亚半岛东比利牛斯山区的内陆国家，北邻法国，南接西班牙，首都为安道尔城。它由1278年的共治协议形成，长期由乌赫尔主教与法国方面的代表共同治理，1993年颁布宪法成为主权国家并加入联合国，现为议会制公国，两共同君主为国家元首。
politics.en: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula in the eastern Pyrenees, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south, with Andorra la Vella as its capital. Formed by a paréage agreement in 1278, it was long governed jointly by the Bishop of Urgell and a French representative, adopted a constitution in 1993 as a sovereign state and joined the United Nations; it is now a parliamentary principality with two co-princes as heads of state.

economy.zh: 经济以旅游业、商业与金融服务业为基础，免税购物与冬季滑雪吸引大量游客，服务业占经济绝大部分，本地农业与畜牧业规模很小。
economy.en: The economy rests on tourism, retail and financial services, with duty-free shopping and winter skiing drawing large numbers of visitors, services accounting for the great majority of output, and local farming and herding remaining very small.

culture.zh: 安道尔文化以加泰罗尼亚语与传统为基础，加泰罗尼亚语为唯一官方语言，罗马式教堂与山地村落构成文化景观，舞蹈、节庆与山地农牧传统延续至今。
culture.en: Andorran culture rests on Catalan language and tradition, Catalan being the only official language, its Romanesque churches and mountain villages forming the cultural landscape, and dance, festivals and mountain farming traditions continuing today. Its mountain churches are the oldest buildings in the country.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1278年共治协议、1993年宪法与主权国家地位、同年加入联合国，以及此后与欧洲一体化安排的谈判。
events.en: Key moments are the paréage agreement of 1278, the constitution and sovereign status of 1993, its accession to the United Nations the same year and the negotiations over its arrangements with European integration since then.

value.zh: 1278年共治协议形成双共同君主制度。
value.en: The paréage of 1278 created the system of two co-princes.
It adopted a constitution as a sovereign state in 1993.

en: Finland, officially the Republic of Finland, as a Nordic country in Northern Europe
Its borders with Sweden to the north-west, Norway to the north and Russia to the east, with the Gulf of Bothnia and the Gulf of Finland
zh: 芬兰正式称芬兰共和国，是北欧国家
西北邻瑞典，北接挪威，东连俄罗斯，西临波的尼亚湾，南临芬兰湾

politics.zh: 芬兰共和国是北欧国家，西北邻瑞典，北接挪威，东连俄罗斯，西临波的尼亚湾，南临芬兰湾，首都为赫尔辛基。1917年脱离俄国独立，经历1918年内战与1939至1944年对苏战争，战后实行北欧式福利制度与多党议会制，1995年加入欧洲联盟，为总统与议会共同行使权力的共和制国家。
politics.en: Finland, officially the Republic of Finland, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe, bordered by Sweden to the north-west, Norway to the north and Russia to the east, with the Gulf of Bothnia to the west and the Gulf of Finland to the south, and Helsinki as its capital. It became independent from Russia in 1917, went through a civil war in 1918 and wars with the Soviet Union from 1939 to 1944, and after the war built a Nordic welfare state with multi-party parliamentary politics, joining the European Union in 1995 as a republic in which president and parliament share power.

economy.zh: 经济以林业、机械制造、电子与信息通信技术、清洁能源与服务业为基础，纸浆与纸制品、机械设备与金属制品是重要出口品，研究与教育投入较高。
economy.en: The economy rests on forestry, machinery, electronics and information technology, clean energy and services, with pulp and paper, machinery and metal products among the leading exports, and comparatively high spending on research and education. Its public finances and education system are regularly highly rated.

culture.zh: 芬兰文化以芬兰语与瑞典语双语传统为基础，桑拿、设计、建筑与音乐具有国际影响，西贝柳斯的作品与当代设计构成文化标志，教育与图书馆体系发达。
culture.en: Finnish culture rests on a bilingual tradition of Finnish and Swedish, its sauna, design, architecture and music have international influence, the works of Sibelius and contemporary design are cultural markers, and its education and library systems are highly developed.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1917年独立、1918年内战、1939至1940年冬季战争与1941至1944年继续战争，以及1995年加入欧洲联盟。
events.en: Key moments are independence in 1917, the civil war of 1918, the Winter War of 1939-1940 and the Continuation War of 1941-1944, and accession to the European Union in 1995. It has since joined the euro area and NATO as well.

value.en: It became independent from Russia in 1917.
It joined the European Union in 1995.

en: The Kingdom of the Suebi, also called the Kingdom of Galicia, as a Germanic post-Roman kingdom in the north-west of the Iberian Peninsula
Its establishment in the early fifth century and its annexation by the Visigoths in 585
zh: 苏维汇王国又称加利亚王国，是伊比利亚半岛西北部的日耳曼后罗马王国
5世纪初建立，585年被西哥特人吞并

politics.zh: 苏维汇王国又称加利亚王国，是伊比利亚半岛西北部的日耳曼后罗马王国，5世纪初苏维汇人越过高卢进入半岛后建立，以布拉加为中心。它由本地王统统治，长期与西哥特人、罗马地方势力及加利西亚的本地居民互动，5世纪中叶起皈依基督教并逐步由阿里乌派转向天主教；585年被西哥特国王利奥维吉尔德吞并。
politics.en: The Kingdom of the Suebi, also called the Kingdom of Galicia, was a Germanic post-Roman kingdom in the north-west of the Iberian Peninsula, established after the Suebi crossed Gaul into the peninsula in the early fifth century and centred on Braga. Ruled by local kings, it interacted for generations with the Visigoths, Roman local powers and the inhabitants of Gallaecia, adopted Christianity in the mid-fifth century and moved gradually from Arianism to Catholicism; in 585 the Visigothic king Leovigild annexed it.

economy.zh: 经济以加利西亚的农业、畜牧、渔业与矿产为基础，罗马时期的道路与庄园继续使用，地方市场与教会地产构成经济生活的核心。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, herding, fishing and mining in Gallaecia, the roads and estates of the Roman period remaining in use, and local markets and church lands forming the core of economic life. Its kings also drew revenue from tolls on the roads to the south.

culture.zh: 苏维汇王国留下早期基督教会的组织与主教区体系，布拉加成为宗教中心，拉丁文书与宗教会议记录显示了王国与罗马文化传统的延续，石碑与教堂遗址留下遗存。
culture.en: The kingdom left the organisation and bishoprics of an early Christian church, Braga becoming a religious centre, Latin documents and council records showing the continuity of Roman cultural tradition, and inscribed stones and church sites surviving as remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括5世纪初苏维汇人进入半岛、5世纪中叶皈依基督教、6世纪的内部纷争与宗教转变，以及585年被西哥特人吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the entry of the Suebi into the peninsula in the early fifth century, their conversion to Christianity in the mid-fifth, the internal conflicts and religious change of the sixth and the Visigothic annexation of 585.

en: The Principality of Antioch as one of the Crusader states created during the First Crusade
Its territory in parts of Anatolia and Syria, with Antioch as its centre
zh: 安条克公国是第一次十字军期间建立的十字军国家之一
领有安纳托利亚与叙利亚部分地区，以安条克为中心

politics.zh: 安条克公国是第一次十字军期间建立的十字军国家之一，领有安纳托利亚与叙利亚部分地区，以安条克为中心，1098年由博希蒙德一世建立。它名义上臣属于耶路撒冷王国，实际上独立行事，长期在拜占庭、亚美尼亚与穆斯林诸政权之间周旋；1268年安条克被马穆鲁克苏丹拜巴尔斯攻陷，公国仅余北部据点，最终在14世纪消失。
politics.en: The Principality of Antioch was one of the Crusader states created during the First Crusade, including parts of Anatolia and Syria and centred on Antioch, founded by Bohemond I in 1098. Nominally a vassal of the Kingdom of Jerusalem but acting independently, it manoeuvred for decades among Byzantium, Armenia and the Muslim powers; in 1268 Antioch was taken by the Mamluk sultan Baibars and the principality survived only in northern strongholds, disappearing in the fourteenth century.

economy.zh: 经济以奥龙特斯河流域的农业、丝绸与橄榄油生产以及港口贸易为基础，圣西缅港与拉塔基亚连接地中海商路，过境贸易与关税为公国提供收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Orontes valley, silk and olive oil production and port trade, with the harbour of Saint Symeon and Latakia linking it to Mediterranean routes, and transit trade and customs supplying the principality's revenue.

culture.zh: 安条克公国是拉丁与东方基督教、伊斯兰文化交汇之地，诺曼与法国贵族带来西欧封建制度，希腊与叙利亚教会并存，城堡与教堂建筑留下遗存。
culture.en: The principality was a meeting place of Latin and Eastern Christianity and of Islamic culture, its Norman and French lords bringing western European feudal institutions, Greek and Syriac churches coexisting, and its castles and churches surviving as remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1098年建国、12世纪与拜占庭及赞吉王朝的战争、1268年安条克陷落，以及此后在北部据点的残存与消失。
events.en: Key moments are its foundation in 1098, its wars with Byzantium and the Zengids in the twelfth century, the fall of Antioch in 1268 and the survival and final disappearance of its northern strongholds. Its last strongholds fell to the Mamluks in the following decades.

value.en: It was founded by Bohemond I in 1098.
Antioch was taken by the Mamluks in 1268.

en: Upper Burgundy as a historical region of early medieval Burgundy and a distinctive realm known as the Kingdom of Upper Burgundy from 888
Its union with Lower Burgundy to form the Kingdom of Arles
zh: 上勃艮第是早期中世纪勃艮第的历史地区，888年起为独立的上勃艮第王国
后与下勃艮第合并为阿尔勒王国

politics.zh: 上勃艮第是早期中世纪勃艮第的历史地区，888年起为独立的上勃艮第王国，以日内瓦与洛桑一带为中心，由鲁道夫家族统治。它在西法兰克、东法兰克与意大利诸势力之间保持自主，控制阿尔卑斯山口与罗讷河上游的商路；933年与下勃艮第合并为阿尔勒王国，此后逐步纳入神圣罗马帝国。
politics.en: Upper Burgundy was a historical region in the early medieval Burgundy and a distinctive realm known as the Kingdom of Upper Burgundy, which existed from 888 and was centred on the Geneva and Lausanne area under the Rudolfian family. It preserved its autonomy between the West Frankish, East Frankish and Italian powers and controlled the Alpine passes and the upper Rhone routes; in 933 it was united with Lower Burgundy to form the Kingdom of Arles, which was gradually drawn into the Holy Roman Empire.

economy.zh: 经济以阿尔卑斯山地的畜牧、谷地农业与山口关税为基础，罗讷河上游与日内瓦湖的航运连接地中海与北海方向，修道院是土地开发与贸易的重要参与者。
economy.en: The economy rested on herding in the Alps, farming in the valleys and tolls from the mountain passes, with shipping on the upper Rhone and Lake Geneva linking the Mediterranean with northern routes, and monasteries important in land development and trade.

culture.zh: 上勃艮第位于法兰西、德意志与意大利文化交界，修道院是抄本与学术中心，拉丁礼仪与地方传统并存，罗马时代的城市与道路继续使用，宗教改革前的教会组织在此形成。
culture.en: Upper Burgundy lay where French, German and Italian cultural areas met, its monasteries were centres of manuscripts and learning, Latin liturgy existed alongside local tradition, Roman cities and roads remained in use, and church organisation took shape there before the Reformation.

events.zh: 关键节点包括888年王国建立、10世纪与东西法兰克及意大利的关系、933年与下勃艮第合并为阿尔勒王国，以及此后并入神圣罗马帝国。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the kingdom in 888, its relations with the West and East Frankish realms and Italy in the tenth century, the union with Lower Burgundy in 933 to form the Kingdom of Arles and its later passage into the Holy Roman Empire.

value.en: The Kingdom of Upper Burgundy was founded in 888.

value.zh: 933年与下勃艮第合并为阿尔勒王国。
value.en: In 933 it united with Lower Burgundy to form the Kingdom of Arles.

en: The Beylik of Dulkadir as one of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks, established by the Oghuz Turk clans Bayat, Afshar and Begdili
Its position in eastern Anatolia after the decline of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum
zh: 杜勒卡迪尔是土耳其安纳托利亚贝伊国之一，由乌古斯突厥的巴亚特、阿夫沙尔与贝格迪利诸部建立
在塞尔柱鲁姆苏丹国衰落后兴起于安纳托利亚东部

politics.zh: 杜勒卡迪尔是土耳其安纳托利亚贝伊国之一，由乌古斯突厥的巴亚特、阿夫沙尔与贝格迪利诸部建立，在塞尔柱鲁姆苏丹国衰落后兴起于安纳托利亚东部，以埃尔比斯坦与马拉什为中心。它夹在奥斯曼、马穆鲁克与波斯诸势力之间，长期充当缓冲与盟友；1515年奥斯曼在 Turnadağ 战役中击败并吞并该贝伊国，其地并入奥斯曼行省。
politics.en: The Beylik of Dulkadir was one of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks, established by the Oghuz Turk clans Bayat, Afshar and Begdili after the decline of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum, lying in eastern Anatolia with Elbistan and Maras as its centres. It stood between the Ottomans, the Mamluks and the Persian powers, serving for generations as a buffer and ally; in 1515 the Ottomans defeated and annexed it at the battle of Turnadag, and its lands became an Ottoman province.

economy.zh: 经济以安纳托利亚东部的畜牧、农业与过境商路贸易为基础，马拉什与埃尔比斯坦是市场城镇，牲畜、谷物与纺织品是主要交换物，商路连接叙利亚与安纳托利亚内地。
economy.en: The economy rested on herding, farming and transit trade in eastern Anatolia, with Maras and Elbistan as market towns, livestock, grain and textiles among the goods exchanged, and routes linking Syria with the Anatolian interior.

culture.zh: 杜勒卡迪尔赞助突厥语文学与伊斯兰建筑，清真寺、经学院与陵墓留下遗存，土库曼部落传统与定居城市文化并存，苏菲道堂在社会生活中活跃。
culture.en: The beylik patronised Turkish literature and Islamic architecture, its mosques, colleges and tombs surviving as remains, Turkmen tribal tradition existing alongside settled urban culture, and Sufi lodges active in social life. Its tribal cavalry long served neighbouring rulers as auxiliaries.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪中叶贝伊国建立、15世纪在奥斯曼与马穆鲁克之间的周旋、1515年 Turnadağ 战役，以及此后被奥斯曼吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the beylik in the mid-fourteenth century, its manoeuvring between the Ottomans and Mamluks in the fifteenth, the battle of Turnadag in 1515 and its annexation by the Ottomans afterwards.

value.zh: 由乌古斯突厥巴亚特、阿夫沙尔与贝格迪利诸部建立。
value.en: It was established by the Oghuz Turk clans Bayat, Afshar and Begdili.

value.zh: 1515年 Turnadağ 战役后被奥斯曼吞并。
value.en: The Ottomans annexed it after the battle of Turnadag in 1515.

en: The Judicate of Cagliari as one of the four kingdoms or judicates into which Sardinia was divided
Its position in the south of the island with its centre near Cagliari
zh: 卡利亚里王国又称卡利亚里裁判国，是撒丁岛分成的四个王国之一
位于岛屿南部，以卡利亚里一带为中心

politics.zh: 卡利亚里王国又称卡利亚里裁判国，是撒丁岛分成的四个王国之一，位于岛屿南部，以卡利亚里一带为中心，由称为裁判者的君主统治。它在11至12世纪与比萨、热那亚及教宗争夺撒丁的控制权，南部平原与盐场是权力基础；13世纪在比萨与热那亚的争夺中解体，其地先后落入比萨与阿拉贡势力范围。
politics.en: The Judicate of Cagliari was one of the four kingdoms or judicates into which Sardinia was divided, lying in the south of the island with its centre in the Cagliari area and ruled by monarchs called judges. Through the eleventh and twelfth centuries it contested control of Sardinia with Pisa, Genoa and the papacy, its power resting on the southern plains and salt pans; in the thirteenth century it broke up amid the rivalry of Pisa and Genoa, its lands passing into Pisan and later Aragonese hands.

economy.zh: 经济以南部平原的农业、盐场与港口贸易为基础，卡利亚里湾的港口连接意大利半岛与北非市场，盐、谷物与皮革是主要交换物，沼泽排水与灌溉工程支撑农业。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming on the southern plains, salt works and port trade, with the harbours of the Cagliari gulf linking the Italian peninsula with North African markets, salt, grain and hides among the goods exchanged, and drainage and irrigation works supporting agriculture.

culture.zh: 卡利亚里王国保存撒丁语言与传统，早期基督教教堂与罗马式建筑留下遗存，裁判者的文书与法律惯例记录了地方制度，比萨的影响体现在城市与宗教建筑中。
culture.en: The judicate preserved Sardinian language and tradition, early Christian churches and Romanesque buildings survive as remains, the documents and legal customs of its judges record local institutions, and Pisan influence is visible in its towns and churches.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9至10世纪裁判国的形成、11至12世纪与比萨及热那亚的争夺、13世纪的解体，以及此后并入比萨与阿拉贡势力范围。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the judicate in the ninth and tenth centuries, the contests with Pisa and Genoa in the eleventh and twelfth, its break-up in the thirteenth and its passage into Pisan and later Aragonese hands.

value.zh: 位于撒丁岛南部，以卡利亚里一带为中心。
value.en: It lay in southern Sardinia with its centre in the Cagliari area.

value.zh: 13世纪在比萨与热那亚争夺中解体。
value.en: It broke up in the thirteenth century amid the rivalry of Pisa and Genoa.

en: The Vandals as a group of Germanic peoples first mentioned by Roman writers in the first and second centuries
Their migration across Gaul and Iberia and their kingdom in North Africa
zh: 汪达尔人是日耳曼民族群体，1至2世纪起见于罗马作家记载
后越过高卢与伊比利亚，在北非建立王国

politics.zh: 汪达尔人是日耳曼民族群体，1至2世纪起见于罗马作家记载，4至5世纪越过高卢与伊比利亚进入北非，439年攻占迦太基并建立汪达尔王国，以迦太基为都。王国由盖塞里克及其后裔统治，拥有强大海军，455年曾攻入罗马；534年拜占庭将领贝利撒留征服北非，王国灭亡。
politics.en: The Vandals were a group of Germanic peoples first mentioned in passing by Roman writers in the first and second centuries, who crossed Gaul and Iberia and entered North Africa in the fourth and fifth centuries, taking Carthage in 439 and founding a kingdom there with Carthage as its capital. Ruled by Gaiseric and his successors and possessing a strong fleet, they entered Rome in 455; in 534 the Byzantine general Belisarius conquered North Africa and the kingdom came to an end.

economy.zh: 经济以罗马时期遗留的北非谷物产区、橄榄油与港口贸易为基础，迦太基与希波等港口连接地中海东西，谷物与橄榄油输往意大利与东部帝国。
economy.en: The economy rested on the North African grain lands and olive groves inherited from Rome and on port trade, with Carthage and Hippo linking the eastern and western Mediterranean and grain and olive oil shipped to Italy and the eastern empire.

culture.zh: 汪达尔人信奉阿里乌派基督教，与北非天主教社群关系紧张，拉丁文学与教会传统在王国境内延续，镶嵌艺术与建筑留下遗存，其名称后来在欧洲语言中带有破坏之意。
culture.en: The Vandals followed Arian Christianity and were often at odds with the Catholic communities of North Africa, while Latin literature and church tradition continued within the kingdom, its mosaics and buildings survive as remains, and its name later carried connotations of destruction in European languages.

events.zh: 关键节点包括406年渡过莱茵河、5世纪初经高卢进入伊比利亚、439年攻占迦太基，以及534年被拜占庭征服。
events.en: Key moments are the crossing of the Rhine in 406, the passage through Gaul into Iberia in the early fifth century, the capture of Carthage in 439 and the Byzantine conquest of 534. Their name was later used for the kingdom they founded in Africa.

value.en: They took Carthage in 439 and founded their kingdom there.

value.zh: 534年被拜占庭将领贝利撒留征服。
value.en: The Byzantine general Belisarius conquered them in 534.
